description:
## Issue summary

Next.js UI for Performance optimisation frontend using design system tokens and accessible states.

**Project:** great-ptw-loto-ai-app
**Sprint:** SP-08.02 (Execution order: 14)
**Layer:** FE
**Priority:** Medium (3)

## Positive test cases

- UI renders loading, empty, success and error states
- Works across themes, light/dark and responsive breakpoints
- API errors surfaced without losing form data
- Safety-critical actions require confirmation
- Navigation and RBAC-gated routes behave correctly

## Negative test cases

- Hardcoded colours bypassing design tokens
- Status communicated by colour alone
- Client trusts frontend permissions without server enforcement
- Broken layout on tablet/mobile

## Acceptance criteria

- Pages wired to API client
- TypeScript lint/build passes
- Matches approved UI patterns

## Definition of Done

- `npm run build -w web` passes
- Manual smoke test documented
- Accessible labels/icons for status

---

## Existing notes

Performance optimisation implementation for **SP-08.02 — Security & Performance Hardening**.

Covers the Performance & Scalability Strategy (Implementation Plan §14) across frontend, backend, database and mobile layers.

## Areas of work

* Frontend performance tuning (Next.js bundle size, code-splitting, image optimisation)
* Backend performance tuning (NestJS query optimisation, N+1 elimination, response times)
